cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Show Me the Score
cards.instruction: Find out how they measure success, what they stand to gain, and where you currently rank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What do you gain if your cousin beats me in the club election?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me one proposal to price. What would make me as competent?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cost it. If I get you that car park, do I move ahead of your cousin on your ballot?
